stage0010_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「The Jindai High students were evacuated first.」

stage0010_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$宗介$$
「No need to worry.
　I will get you somewhere safe, without fail.」

stage0010_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What is going on!?
　What in the world is happening!?」

stage0010_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Who are you!?
　Where are you taking me!? What's the plan!?
　Explain everything!」

stage0010_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Truth is, I've been tailing you
　ever since I transferred in.」

stage0010_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I already figured that out!
　So tell me what's actually going on!」

stage0010_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$宗介$$
「All I know is you're something special,
　and an armed group wanted you for experiments.」

stage0010_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$かなめ$$
「An armed group, terrorists!?
　And experiments, on me...!?」

stage0010_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$宗介$$
「To prevent that from happening,
　$$ミスリル$$ sent a soldier as your guard...
　That soldier is me.」

stage0010_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am Sergeant $$相良宗介$$ of $$ミスリル$$.
　Callsign $$ウルズ$$ 7, ID number B3128.」

stage0010_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$かなめ$$
「L-listen... Sagara.
　I get it, loud and clear...
　you're a total military nut...」

stage0010_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you can't be serious...!
　You're not planning to pilot that Arm Slave!?」

stage0010_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey! What are you thinking!
　No matter how hardcore a military nut you are,
　an amateur can't pilot a robot like that!」

stage0010_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am not an amateur.
　I am a specialist.」

stage0010_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No way...
　He's really... piloting a robot...」

stage0010_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$宗介$$
「That silver AS...!
　It's a type I've never seen!」

stage0010_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$宗介$$
「What is that movement...!
　That's not AS-level speed!」

stage0010_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ha ha ha, can you hear me, schoolboy!
　Didn't expect to meet again like this!」

stage0010_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That busted hatch gives me a good look at your face.
　I see... quite the sharp look to you.」

stage0010_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Heh heh heh... hah hah hah!
　Well, I'll be, you're Kashim!」

stage0010_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I never noticed!
　You, playing high schooler in Japan, of all things!」

stage0010_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What happened to $$カリーニン$$?
　Is that coward doing well too?」

stage0010_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Come to think of it, you shot my forehead once...
　But too bad for you.」

stage0010_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「An old wound left a titanium plate
　embedded in my skull, you see.
　Shallow angle too, I got lucky.」

stage0010_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But to think we'd meet again like this...!
　This is great, perfect, even!
　But there's a mountain to catch up on, later!」

stage0010_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I've got a job messing with the brain
　of that girl you ran off with.
　Think of it as a little treasure hunt.」

stage0010_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Yeah, that girl's head is packed full
　of Black Technology, applied theory
　for the Lambda Driver, among other things.」

stage0010_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Once it's finished, they say
　it'll make even nukes meaningless.」

stage0010_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「...Guess you don't know.
　But I won't tell you now.」

stage0010_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$宗介$$
「An AT...!
　The one called $$キリコ$$, from before!?」

stage0010_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll cover you.
　Take the woman and go.」

stage0010_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$宗介$$
「This AS won't hold up any longer!
　We evacuate on foot!」

stage0010_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「All right, Kashim!
　Let's see how far you can run!」

stage0010_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now then, $$キリコ$$...!
　Let's see if you're as skilled
　as the rumors say!」

stage0010_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Just one AT alone, how far can you go...
　Show me, right here!」

stage0010_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That person... will he be okay
　out there alone...」

stage0010_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't think about anything else.
　Just focus on staying alive.」

stage0010_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's a natural reaction.
　From where you stand, I probably look...」

stage0010_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「But all I can think about
　is getting you home safely.」

stage0010_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't promise we'll make it out,
　but will you trust me?」

stage0010_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Oh... a guest decided to show up too?」

stage0010_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Not bad, Dog 1!
　You're holding your own in this mess!」

stage0010_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アルト$$
「That $$スコープドッグ$$...!
　Is that $$キリコ$$!?」

stage0010_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　Callsign Dog 1...
　$$キリコ・キュービィー$$.」

stage0010_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$n
「So that AT pilot's an ex-$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ member too...」

stage0010_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「You and the others know $$キリコ$$, $$マオ$$?」

stage0010_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Of course.
　We're the ones who scouted him
　into $$ミスリル$$, after all.」

stage0010_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Heh... to have an eye for someone like him,
　that's quite the judgment.」

stage0010_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Under Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$'s command,
　the Echoes has moved to rescue
　Sergeant Sagara and $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0010_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$オットー$$
「All right...!
　Have the mobile unit engage the enemy AS force!」

stage0010_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Oh-ho...
　Getting bold now that the jet's fled, huh.」

stage0010_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I don't like that kind of thing...!」

stage0010_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Get out of there, $$キリコ$$!」

stage0010_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Not bad...
　No wonder $$マーティアル$$ calls you 'Untouchable'.」

stage0010_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But I don't care about taboos!」

stage0010_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Impressive, $$キリコ$$!
　Ejecting right before it blew!」

stage0010_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Guess I'll make up for this
　unsatisfied feeling with that bunch over there.」

stage0010_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$エマ$$
「That speed and firepower just now...
　it's beyond any normal AS!」

stage0010_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lieutenant $$キャシー$$!
　Transmit the combat data from just now
　to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$!」

stage0010_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well then... guess I'll throw in
　everything we've got too.」

stage0010_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Damn it!
　Now the $$ファイヤバグ$$s are showing up too!」

stage0010_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「But the one we need to watch most
　is that silver AS!」

stage0010_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$くらら$$
「That aura it's giving off...
　it's like our own wild instincts...」

stage0010_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0010_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$オットー$$
「There's no choice but to fight!
　Tell all units to be wary of that mystery AS!」

stage0010_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$...
　could it be that this is where we...」

stage0010_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now then, it's party time!
　Watch as your friends get torn apart...
　sit tight and watch, Kashim!」

stage0010_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've already reported our position,
　but in this chaos, it may be difficult.」

stage0010_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$宗介$$
「And by my assessment,
　we're gradually being cornered...」

stage0010_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Chidori, I'll stay and draw their fire.
　I intend to buy us as much time as I can.」

stage0010_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Take this radio and run.
　The rescue team should find you with it.」

stage0010_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm the only one who runs?」

stage0010_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Our job is to protect you.
　You've earned the right to live.
　...Now go.」

stage0010_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I said no!
　Sagara, you really are an idiot!」

stage0010_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't tell me you're actually
　thinking it's fine to die anytime,
　some half-baked nonsense like that!?」

stage0010_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You think that's cool or something?
　Dying for your own self-satisfaction,
　without even thinking of how I'd feel!」

stage0010_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You know what! Being saved by a gloomy,
　military-nut idiot like you...
　doesn't make me happy in the least!」

stage0010_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No buts, no cuts, no dodging the issue!
　I already told you...
　I don't want to be the only one saved!」

stage0010_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sagara... you told me to trust you earlier, right?
　So I... I trusted you.」

stage0010_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$かなめ$$
「As long as you were by my side,
　I knew I could get through anything...」

stage0010_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No matter how battered I got,
　no matter how much it hurt, like I'd die,
　I knew I could keep pushing through...」

stage0010_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So please... don't say such lonely things.
　Let's go home together, Sagara.」

stage0010_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...There was once a man who valued his life cheaply.
　But that man never understood what life meant.」

stage0010_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying I'm the same?」

stage0010_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「At least, that woman believes so.」

stage0010_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Weren't you supposed to escape
　together with that man, $$デュオ$$?」

stage0010_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「One person can pilot a jet.」

stage0010_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What did they do to you?」

stage0010_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not really sure...
　They called it a supplement, but made me
　drink odd pills, or showed weird videos...」

stage0010_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$宗介$$
「That thing with the scientific terms?」

stage0010_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「All sorts of characters, changing one after another.」

stage0010_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Base material for a disc damper,
　or reactant for a palladium reactor...」

stage0010_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The $$ＥＣＳ$$'s invisible mode isn't finished at all...
　It just strains the laser screen emitters,
　and there's so much ozone smell...」

stage0010_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Why do you know that much...?」

stage0010_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Eh... ah... I don't know.
　But somehow, I just know...」

stage0010_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Words I shouldn't even know,
　but I've known since before I was born,
　that... Black Technology, I think it's called...」

stage0010_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Me... what did I just...?
　Ah, I sound like a crazy person... haha...」

stage0010_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, was it...
　Did you stay to interrogate Chidori?」

stage0010_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You have your own duty to attend to.
　...It's about time.」

stage0010_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Go, $$相良宗介$$.
　That unit was launched straight at you.」

stage0010_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Understood!
　I'm trusting you with Chidori!」

stage0010_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アル$$
「Voiceprint check initiated.
　Name and ID number.」

stage0010_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アル$$
「Verification complete.
　Confirmed: Sergeant Sagara.
　Awaiting orders.」

stage0010_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Hatch closed.
　Adjusting to Mode 4.
　Bilateral angle, 3.5.」

stage0010_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Sergeant Sagara, this recording
　proceeds on the assumption that you've
　linked up with the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$.」

stage0010_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That AS's AI callsign is $$アル$$.
　It's a costly prototype, so bring it back.
　That's all. Good luck.」

stage0010_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's right.
　Sorry to worry you.」

stage0010_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$マオ$$
「It's fine.
　But that silver AS is a monster.」

stage0010_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$宗介$$
「That is an enemy I must defeat.」

stage0010_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$キリコ$$
「If it's an AT, this base has plenty.」

stage0010_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アルト$$
「As expected of the immortal man!」

stage0010_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Kashim!
　Did you come back to entertain me!?」

stage0010_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... he's our top-priority target.」

stage0010_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$宗介$$
「This time, I'll take him down...!」

stage0010_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宗介$$
「Ngh...!
　Unless I defeat $$ガウルン$$, we're finished...」

stage0010_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is fun, Kashim!
　Dance with me a little longer!」

stage0010_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll ask again.
　Who has the advantage?」

stage0010_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...In a normal fight, they'd be evenly matched.
　But that silver AS's power is off the charts.」

stage0010_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Black Technology...
　The enemy has it.
　But his unit doesn't...」

stage0010_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He'll lose, if this keeps up...」

stage0010_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's finish this, Kashim!
　See ya!」

stage0010_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm alive...
　Unscathed, after taking that hit!?」

stage0010_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アル$$
「Main system boot-up wizard running.
　System unlocked.」

stage0010_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$宗介$$
「The Lambda Driver...!?
　What is that!?」

stage0010_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What is that?
　Do you know?」

stage0010_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He doesn't know how to use it...!
　A strong urge to defend himself...!」

stage0010_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've always... just been protected...!
　This time... I'll do... pseudo phase interference...
　Ngh... nngh!」

stage0010_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm borrowing your radio!
　...$$宗介$$, can you hear me!?」

stage0010_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Listen carefully!
　Your enemy has a special device installed!
　A machine that turns attack impulses into force!」

stage0010_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A-and... I don't know why, but,
　your AS has it too... the Lambda Driver...
　it's installed in yours too!」

stage0010_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just now, you wanted to protect yourself, right?
　The device responded to that!
　The strong image in your mind takes shape!」

stage0010_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$宗介$$
「An image, taking physical form...?
　No weapon like that could exist...」

stage0010_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What are you dawdling for!?」

stage0010_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He meant to tear you to pieces just now!
　But he couldn't!」

stage0010_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You can even counterattack...!
　Focus hard, and picture beating him!
　Put your spirit into it! All in one instant!」

stage0010_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Hahahaha! I see, that could well be true!
　You're the ones who guarded a $$ウィスパード$$,
　so it's no surprise you'd have it!」

stage0010_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you doing!? Spirit! Spirit!」

stage0010_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've been trying this whole time!
　No force field is showing up!」

stage0010_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Listen, $$宗介$$.
　What matters is concentration!」

stage0010_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Breathe deep, and the instant you exhale,
　pour your spirit into your shots and limbs!」

stage0010_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That voice...!
　Is $$ヒイロ$$ there too!?」

stage0010_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Listen, $$相良宗介$$.
　If you lose, $$千鳥かなめ$$ will suffer an ordeal
　severe enough to break her mind.」

stage0010_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What does that mean, $$キャシー$$?」

stage0010_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Explain it to her, $$クラン$$.」

stage0010_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　You don't need to imagine it!」

stage0010_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You...!
　I'm putting up with a public execution here,
　and that's your reaction!?」

stage0010_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'll spell it out for you!」

stage0010_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If you lose, I'll be stripped naked,
　groped all over, and then killed!
　Picture it!」

stage0010_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You don't want that, do you?」

stage0010_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's exactly what he's planning...!
　Can you really forgive that!?」

stage0010_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I understand...
　That white AS is answering $$宗介$$'s feelings!」

stage0010_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Kashim!
　Finally getting serious, are you!」

stage0010_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A clash between Lambda Drivers!
　This is gonna be one flashy fight!」

stage0010_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$宗介$$
「But the one who wins... is me!!」

stage0010_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「To break the barrier around his unit,
　hit it with both units' full-power attacks!
　Unleash a Maximum Break!」

stage0010_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But more important than that... is spirit!」

stage0010_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Enemy forces confirmed wiped out.」

stage0010_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Also, we've received word from $$プリベンター$$
　that the jet carrying the other passengers
　was safely secured as well.」

stage0010_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then there's no need to linger here!
　Let's pull out, quickly!」

stage0010_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good work, Dog 1.
　That's some skill.」

stage0010_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Figured as much, but that silent act of yours
　makes a fine pair with $$宗介$$.」

stage0010_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Dog 1... no, $$キリコ$$.
　I appreciate your help.」

stage0010_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Never mind that, shouldn't you get going?」

stage0010_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good work, Dog 1.
　That's some skill.」

stage0010_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess the 'immortal man' rumors weren't just talk.」

stage0010_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$マオ$$
「Still, you were awfully cooperative with $$宗介$$.」

stage0010_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness...
　I'm so glad Chidori is really safe...」

stage0010_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Heh... so your funny bunch of friends
　were in on it, protecting me all along.」

stage0010_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Let's go home, Chidori.
　Back to everyone at Jindai High School.」

stage0010_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「For a battleship,
　to push so aggressively to the front lines...
　That's Captain $$ジェフリー$$, a true veteran.」

stage0010_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$オットー$$
「Grrgh...
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ can do it too!
　We won't lose to $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$!」

stage0010_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As expected from this squad's core.
　Reliable as ever.」

stage0010_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch!
　Me, in a place like this...!」

stage0010_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$クルツ$$
「We got it!
　That's the end of that monster AS!」

stage0010_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$マオ$$
「I heard the one piloting that thing
　was some old enemy of $$宗介$$'s?」

stage0010_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... an enemy is just an enemy.」

stage0010_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$宗介$$
（That's how it is, $$ガウルン$$.
　I probably won't think of you again.）

stage0010_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$n
「Someone's here, in a place like this!?」

stage0010_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
???
「Sorry 'bout that, bud.
　Guess I gave you a scare.」

stage0010_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$n
「What are you doing!?
　This is a battlefield!」

stage0010_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
???
「I can see that much just by looking.
　It's situations like this where you can
　scavenge good parts amid the chaos.」

stage0010_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
???
「I know, bud.
　I don't wanna die either, you know.」

stage0010_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
???
「Call this an apology for the scare.
　Take one of my prized parts.」

stage0010_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$キリコ$$
（I fight so I can live in this world with you.）

stage0010_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A new-model AS, huh!
　You've turned into quite the worthwhile prey
　to crush, Kashim!」

stage0010_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be so cold!
　It's a reunion, let's enjoy it to the fullest!」

stage0010_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no business with you!」

stage0010_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is the best, Kashim!
　We're fighting the first-ever battle between
　Lambda Driver-equipped units!」

stage0010_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know what this equipment is,
　but I'll master it if it means beating you!」

stage0010_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Nice, nice, Kashim!
　That killing intent recalls the old you, a bit!」

stage0010_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「The pure, unblemished killing intent you were then!」

stage0010_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up, $$ガウルン$$!
　I'll shut that running mouth of yours right now!」

stage0010_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I know you, $$マジンガーＺ$$!
　You're a lot smaller than in the movies!」

stage0010_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ha! Just kidding, just kidding!
　As an apology, want to play, Super Robot?」

stage0010_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$甲児$$
「You...!
　You'll regret coming at me and Mazinger
　half as a joke!」

stage0010_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well, well, if it isn't Mr. Grade-School President!」

stage0010_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait, am I famous or something!?」

stage0010_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Your toy is impressive, Mr. President,
　but my AS has something fun loaded too.」

stage0010_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't treat my Trider, passed down from Dad,
　like it's some toy!」

stage0010_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Your polite talk almost fooled me,
　but you're a real piece of work, villain!」

stage0010_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you're a villain, no mercy!
　I'll beat you down with the Trider
　you called a toy!」

stage0010_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「The famous $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ boy detective, huh.
　Diligence is fine, but pry too deep into
　grown-up business and you'll get hurt.」

stage0010_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I know about you, $$ガウルン$$!
　A terrifying man wanted across the whole world!」

stage0010_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Coming at me, of all people...
　My, my, a child's ignorance really is scary.」

stage0010_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That confidence ends here, villain!
　$$鉄人$$ will take you down for sure!」

stage0010_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Sheesh... a noisy fly buzzing overhead...」

stage0010_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$アルト$$
「That AS...!
　Looks like he's toying with us, no openings...!」

stage0010_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ho... you can handle yourself a bit, bud.
　I'll give you that.」

stage0010_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't screw around!
　Don't think you can keep toying with us forever!」

stage0010_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Then, bud...!
　Try and make me serious, if you can!」

stage0010_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ho... keeping up with my moves like that,
　maybe you're one of those Newtypes.」

stage0010_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...!
　He's fighting like it's all a game!」

stage0010_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What's wrong with that?
　Isn't life basically just a game?」

stage0010_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know how dangerous a man like that is!
　I have to stop him here!」

stage0010_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$葵$$
「I know...!
　He's a beast chasing thrills just like us!」

stage0010_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You can always spot a kindred spirit.
　Let's get friendly, ladies.」

stage0010_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Be quiet!
　We are nothing like you, a war profiteer
　spreading his desires around!」

stage0010_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Details don't matter!
　Let's hurry up and enjoy this killing spree!」

stage0010_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$葵$$
「Shut up, war profiteer!
　I've got no intention of dealing with a man like you!」

stage0010_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Never thought, in a place like this,
　I'd meet the rumored 'Untouchable'...
　today's one heck of a lucky day!」

stage0010_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Seems like you've got no interest in your own rumors...」

stage0010_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But get ready!
　Your existence will surely spark conflict!」

stage0010_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Looks like you're this squad's captain!」

stage0010_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「As expected of the captain!
　Guess it takes one to know one!」

stage0010_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Even so, I can't back down!
　I'm the one who has to stop him!」

stage0010_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Hey, hey!
　What's a rookie doing out here, huh!」

stage0010_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$リディ$$
「I may be inexperienced, sure,
　but as a member of Londo Bell, I have a duty!」

stage0010_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I like it, green boy!
　Guess I'll teach you the harshest reality
　of the battlefield there is!」

stage0010_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$リディ$$
「I refuse!
　I've got no intention of dying yet either!」

stage0010_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$n
「The way I am now, I can't beat that man...」

stage0010_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Bold of you, boy...!
　But if you don't put up a fight,
　it's no fun for me!」

stage0010_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$n
「Don't get the wrong idea, wild dog.
　Just because I can't win doesn't mean
　I'll bow to someone like you...!」

stage0010_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$n
「You put people close to me in danger...!」

stage0010_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$甲児$$
「How dare you put my whole class in danger!」

stage0010_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$甲児$$
「I won't forgive you!
　As the representative of Class 2-4, I'll unleash
　everyone's anger!!」

stage0010_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$アルト$$
（We'd only known each other a month...
　and I barely even spoke to them myself,
　yet here I am, feeling like this...）

stage0010_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$アルト$$
「Here goes...!
　For the whole class's sake, I won't forgive you!!」

stage0010_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$n
（Right now, my chest is filled with anger
　at seeing people I care about put in danger...!）

stage0010_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$n
（That anger... you're going to feel it!!）

stage0010_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「The girls in class, and Miss Kagurazaka too...
　they must've been terrified...」

stage0010_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'll have you pay that price
　with your own bodies!」

stage0010_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「For those who put everyone in danger,
　there's no mercy to spare!」

stage0010_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$ボス$$
「Yo!
　I'm the $$ボス$$ watching over Class 2-4!
　I'll settle the whole class's debt at once!!」

stage0010_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$さやか$$
（Wait for me, $$かなめ$$, $$詩織$$, $$恭子$$...）

stage0010_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$さやか$$
（Everyone was kind to me when I'd just transferred in...
　I'll take down whoever scared them!）
